title: Vegetarian Breakfast Banh Mi with Fried Egg
summary: A Vietnamese-inspired baguette-style breakfast roll filled with a crisp fried egg, quick pickled carrot, fresh coriander and a tangy chilli-mayo style sauce. It is bright, savoury and satisfying for a fast vegetarian breakfast.

ingredients.name: wholemeal bread rolls or baguette-style rolls

steps: Put the carrot matchsticks in a bowl with the rice vinegar, sugar and salt. Toss well and leave to pickle for at least 15 minutes, stirring once or twice, until slightly softened but still crisp.
Mix the mayonnaise, sriracha and soy sauce in a small bowl to make a savoury chilli mayo.
Split the bread rolls and warm them in a dry pan or oven for 2–3 minutes until lightly crisp on the outside.

Heat the vegetable oil in a non-stick frying pan over medium-high heat. Crack in the eggs and fry for 2–3 minutes until the whites are set and the edges are crisp; leave the yolks runny or cook longer if preferred. Season with black pepper.
Spread the chilli mayo inside the warm rolls. Add cucumber slices, drained pickled carrot, coriander and chilli slices.
Place a fried egg in each roll, close gently and serve straight away while the egg is hot and the bread is crisp.
